verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs explicitly describe automatic triggering: Claude loads a skill when it judges the description relevant, and the spec requires descriptions to state 'what it does and when to use it' (docs-2, docs-3, docs-25, docs-32, docs-44). But multiple independent hands-on reports directly contradict reliable auto-activation — users report skills 'aren't triggered when I would expect,' are 'hit or miss' even with proper YAML/semantic triggers, and some find explicit invocation or dumping instructions into AGENTS.md necessary instead (anthropic-skills-comm-6 through -14). Missing for 10: vendor-side benchmarks/evidence of triggering accuracy, and resolution of the documented real-world inconsistency.
